en.description: Track sneaker prices over time, see which types went up and spot where the market is heading, all in one personal dashboard.

landing.headline: See which sneakers got pricier before you buy
landing.subheadline: Built for sneaker buyers who want to log prices, compare them week by week and spot rising trends, starting with the first pair you watch.

features.title: Log every price you see
features.description: Add a model with its current and previous price so each change is on record.

features.title: Spot rising trends
features.description: See at a glance what share of your tracked pairs is rising, stable or falling.

features.title: Filter by sneaker type
features.description: Narrow your list to running, basketball, lifestyle or skate to compare like with like.

features.title: Board by price trend
features.description: Move entries between rising, stable and falling columns as the market shifts.

landing.featuresHeading: Everything you need to follow prices

steps.title: Sign in with Google
steps.description: Open your private space where only you see your price log.

steps.title: Add the sneakers you watch
steps.description: Record the model, type, previous price, current price and date checked.

steps.title: Mark the trend
steps.description: Set each pair as rising, stable or falling after every check.

steps.title: Read your dashboard
steps.description: Check the share of rising prices and see which types are heading up.

items.question: Who is this for?
items.answer: It is made for one person who wants to follow sneaker prices and see which types are getting more expensive.

items.question: Do I need to enter prices myself?
items.answer: Yes. You add each price you find, and the app keeps the history and shows the trend.

items.question: Is my price log private?
items.answer: You sign in with Google, and your entries live in your own account area.

items.question: Are the examples on this page real prices?
items.answer: No. The sneakers shown here are illustrative examples that show how tracking looks.

dashboard.title: Your price overview
dashboard.intro: See how many sneakers you track and how many of them are getting more expensive.
